correctness.rationale: The actual RESULT.md at blob 4c4f232f gives X′=λX+(1−λ)S and Y′=γY−(γ−1)S. Stationarity gives E X=E Y=E S=m, and Var(S)=1−m². Centered covariance identities and Cauchy–Schwarz give sqrt(Var X/(1−m²))∈[c,1], c=(1−λ)/(1+λ), and sqrt(Var Y/(1−m²))∈[d,1], d=(γ−1)/(γ+1), for |m|<1. Upper equality yields X=S or Y=S and, from stationarity of the opposite defect under multiplier λ or γ, support on the two fixed corners. Lower equality yields S′=−S and m=0, then X=−cS,Y=dS, with the branch admissibility precisely d+kc>0. |m|=1 forces corner Diracs by stationarity. The inspected verify.py symbolically factors the scalar inequalities and checks orbit/branch identities, but analytic stationarity supplies the proof.
